recentItems.title: Ed Sheeran REACTS to Macklemore’s removal from tour over ‘Free Palestine’ remarks | Hollywood News
recentItems.description:
Ed Sheeran has addressed Macklemore’s removal from his U.S. tour following the rapper’s “Free Palestine” remarks. Sheeran clarified that the decision was made by the tour promoter, not by him.
